clips.expected: Cemented means already forced by your story. Loose means still open; it is not automatically wrong.
clips.approximateTranscript: Cemented means already forced by your story. Loose means still open. It is not automatically wrong.

clips.expected: Follow what the blocks force, rather than choose whatever sounds nice. Finish every question without a collapse. How to play is free. The Hint button shows its heart cost. Think first, then check your answer.
clips.approximateTranscript: Follow with the block's force, rather than choose whatever sounds nice. Finish every question without a collapse. How to play is free. The hint button shows its heart cost. Think first, then check your answer.

clips.expected: Click a switch to change true/false. Example: true AND false gives false; true OR false gives true; NOT true gives false.
clips.approximateTranscript: Click a switch to change true false. Example true and false gives false. True or false gives true not true gives false.

clips.expected: Wire mode: click an output socket on the right, then an input socket on the left, or drag between them. Connect the last output to the bulb. Match every table row.

clips.approximateTranscript: Example, a T-shape has four odd points. A single stroke can have only two ends, so that shape cannot be drawn in one stroke.
